name: Carlo Maratta

summary.text: Carlo Maratta or Maratti was an Italian Baroque painter and draughtsman, active principally in Rome where he was the leading painter in the second half of the 17th century. He was a fresco and canvas painter who painted in a wide range of genres, including history and portrait painting.

7301981: Rebecca and Eliezer at the Well is an oil painting by Italian artist Carlo Maratta, located in the Indianapolis Museum of Art, which is in Indianapolis, Indiana.
Rebecca and Eliezer at the Well
72671544: The Emperor Augustus Closes the Doors of the Temple of Janus or The Peace of Augustus is a c.1655-1657 oil on canvas painting by Carlo Maratta, one of nine works commissioned by Louis Phélypeaux, Seigneur of La Vrillière for the gilded gallery at his new hôtel de La Vrillière in Paris.
The Emperor Augustus Closes the Doors of the Temple of Janus
111936616: The Madonna of the Rosary is an altarpiece painted in oil by Italian artist Carlo Maratta, located in the Oratory of San Cita for which it was painted, in Palermo, region of Sicily, Italy.
